_doc: 图腾山洞的任务（QuestLog 读取）。图腾按顺序一次给一个新任务（同时最多 3 个进行中）。objectives 的 type：sit（坐到 uid 以 prefix 开头的座位上）、discover（湖边探索点，ids 全部找到）、reach（走到 pos 半径 radius 米内）、zone_event（在仙境出现时进入 zone）、rainbow（在室外看见彩虹）、constellations（发现 count 个星座）、species（图鉴记下 count 种动物）、swim（在 volume 水里游过）、emote_at（在 pos 附近做动作 id）、flag（WorldState.flags 里 key 为真，例如点亮亚特兰蒂斯的尖塔）、letters（读过 count 封划船人的信，PaddlerStory）。constellations 带 ids 时只数这几个星座。requires：这些 WorldState.flags 都为真以前图腾不给这个任务，先说 wait 那句（后面的任务也一起等）。finale：暮烬之夜接着「暮烬之夜」任务去找图腾时，它讲的最后一个故事（一页一句，讲完放终章过场，StoryDirector）。文字都有中英两份。

greeting.zh: ……火还旺着。旅人，你走进我的山洞了。我守在这里很久了，湖边的事，我都想听你讲讲。
greeting.en: ...The fire still burns. Traveller, you have walked into my cave. I have kept watch here a long time, and I would hear what you find by the lake.

all_done.zh: 火还旺着。往后每个晴朗的秋夜，暮烬都会回来。仙境那道月光石门……最近夜里，好像有人在门那边轻轻敲。等它开了，我第一个告诉你。
all_done.en: The fire still burns. Every clear autumn night from now on, the embers will come back. And the moonstone gate in the glade... lately, at night, it sounds as if someone is knocking softly on the other side. When it opens, you will be the first to know.

casual.zh: 火还旺着。今天不用替我跑腿，旅人，想去哪儿就去哪儿。
casual.en: The fire still burns. No errands today, traveller. Go wherever you like.

casual.zh: 湖边的鱼最近很肥。码头尽头那块地方，傍晚最好钓。
casual.en: The fish by the lake are fat these days. The end of the dock is the best spot at dusk.

casual.zh: 晴朗的夜里抬头看看。天上的星座，都是湖边的东西。
casual.en: Look up on a clear night. The constellations are all things from around the lake.

casual.zh: 下雨的时候，木屋里的炉火最好。坐一会儿再走吧。
casual.en: When it rains, the stove in the cabin is the best place to be. Sit a while before you go.

casual.zh: 洞的尽头那道光门，门那边是一片云海。去看看也好，不去也好。
casual.en: Through the gate of light at the end of the cave lies a sea of clouds. Go and see, or don't. Either is fine.

casual.zh: 哈，有朋友来做客的时候，记得带他们去码头跳支舞。
casual.en: Ha! When friends come to visit, take them to dance at the end of the dock.

finale.zh: 你看见了吧，湖上那些一点一点的红光。那是暮烬——长明之火里飘出来的火星。
finale.en: You saw them, did you not? The little red lights over the lake. Those are the embers: sparks drifting up from the fires that never go out.

finale.zh: 很久以前，每个世界都有一个守火人。湖边的火是我守的；云上的风灯、沙里的祭坛、海底的尖塔，也都有人守着。
finale.en: Long ago every world had a fire-keeper. The fire by the lake was mine to keep; the wind lamps above the clouds, the altar in the sand and the spire under the sea all had keepers too.

finale.zh: 后来他们一个一个走远了。火还烧着，可没有人回去点灯。那些世界就停在了黄昏里，一直在等。
finale.en: Then, one by one, they went far away. The fires kept burning, but no one went back to light the lamps. So those worlds stopped at dusk, and waited.

finale.zh: 那个划船的走之前跟我说：等三盏灯都亮了，暮烬就会回到湖上。我守着火，等了很久很久。
finale.en: Before the paddler left, they told me: when the three lamps are lit, the embers will come back to the lake. I kept the fire and waited a long, long time.

finale.zh: 现在灯都亮了，天上也多了三颗星。谢谢你，旅人。我走不了的路，你替我走完了。
finale.en: Now the lamps are all lit, and there are three new stars in the sky. Thank you, traveller. The roads I could not walk, you walked for me.

finale.zh: 去石头小屋看看吧。今晚，那边的灯好像亮了。
finale.en: Go and look at the stone cottage. Tonight, I think, its lamp is lit.

quests.title: 篝火边的老朋友
quests.title_en: An Old Friend by the Fire
quests.offer: 先坐下吧。在篝火边的原木上坐一会儿，听听火的声音。
quests.offer_en: Sit first. Rest on a log by the fire for a while and listen to it.
quests.done: 嗯，你懂得停下来。好，这就够了。
quests.done_en: Good. You know how to stop. That is enough.

objectives.text_en: Sit on a log by the fire

quests.title: 巡湖
quests.offer: 湖上有三处我惦记的地方：湖心小岛、北岸的芦苇湾、东岸的睡莲湾。划船去看看它们还好不好。
quests.offer_en: There are three places on the lake I think of: the islet, the reed bay in the north and the lily cove in the east. Paddle out and see that they are well.
quests.done: 芦苇还在，睡莲也开着。谢谢你替我看了一眼。
quests.done_en: The reeds stand and the lilies bloom. Thank you for looking for me.

objectives.text: 找到湖心小岛、北岸芦苇湾、东岸睡莲湾
objectives.text_en: Find the islet, North Reed Bay and East Lily Cove

quests.title: 划船人的信
quests.offer: 南边草地上那间石头小屋，从前住着一个爱划船的人。走之前留了三封信：木屋里一封，码头上一封，湖心岛上一封。找来读读，就知道那扇门怎么开了。
quests.offer_en: The stone cottage on the southern meadow once belonged to someone who loved to paddle. Before leaving they left three letters: one in the cabin, one on the dock, one on the islet. Read them and you will know how to open that door.
quests.done: 门开了？那个划船的还是老样子，什么都写下来，就是不写自己去了哪儿。
quests.done_en: The door is open? The paddler never changed: wrote everything down, except where they were going.

objectives.text: 找到并读完划船人的三封信
objectives.text_en: Find and read the paddler's three letters
Open the door of the stone cottage

quests.title: 云上的风灯
quests.offer: 我身后这条洞走到底，有一道光门。门那边是一片云海，云上有四座风灯，熄了很久了。去把它们点亮。
quests.offer_en: Follow this cave to its end and you will find a gate of light. Beyond it lies a sea of clouds, and above the clouds stand four wind lamps that went out long ago. Go and light them.
quests.done: 我在这儿都闻到风了。天鲸游过来了吧？今晚湖上，抬头看看。
quests.done_en: I can smell the wind even from here. The Sky Whale came close, did it not? Look up over the lake tonight.

objectives.text: 点亮云海浮岛的四座风灯
objectives.text_en: Light the four wind beacons in the Cloudsea Isles

quests.title: 登高
quests.offer: 东北角那座雪山，山顶有一堆石头。爬上去，替我看看整片湖。
quests.offer_en: The snow peak in the north-east has a cairn on its top. Climb it and look at the whole lake for me.
quests.done: 从那上面看，湖像一只眼睛，对吧？
quests.done_en: From up there the lake looks like an eye, does it not?

quests.title: 林间的邻居
quests.offer: 这片林子里住着不少小家伙。走近一点，把它们记进你的图鉴（按 J 打开）。记下五种就好。
quests.offer_en: Many small folk live in these woods. Get close and write them into your journal (press J). Five kinds will do.
quests.done: 兔子、狐狸、鸟……它们也认得你了。
quests.done_en: Rabbits, foxes, birds... they know you now too.

objectives.text: 图鉴里记下 5 种动物
objectives.text_en: Record 5 kinds of animals in the journal

quests.title: 沙里的碎片
quests.offer: 南边草甸的西头有一道沙之门。门那边的沙丘里埋着六块古代碎片，原本嵌在神殿的祭坛上。替我把它们放回去。
quests.offer_en: At the west end of the southern meadow stands a gate of sand. In the dunes beyond it lie six ancient shards that once sat in the altar of the temple. Put them back for me.
quests.done: 那道光柱，我在洞里都看见了。沙里的那盏灯，也亮了。
quests.done_en: I saw that pillar of light even from inside the cave. The lamp in the sand is lit as well.

objectives.text: 把六块古代碎片嵌回琥珀沙丘的祭坛
objectives.text_en: Return the six ancient shards to the altar in the Amber Dunes

quests.title: 深潜
quests.offer: 南边那座玻璃房子底下藏着一片海。从泳池底的洞潜下去，游进那口大缸里。
quests.offer_en: Under the glass house in the south a sea is hidden. Dive through the hole in the pool floor and swim into the great tank.
quests.done: 你见到那只像斗篷一样的鱼了吗？它比我还老。
quests.done_en: Did you see the fish that moves like a cloak? It is older than I am.

quests.title: 码头上的舞
quests.offer: 老规矩：天气好的时候，要在码头尽头跳一支舞。按 G 打开动作轮盘。
quests.offer_en: An old custom: in good weather, dance at the end of the dock. Press G for the action wheel.
quests.done_en: Ha! Even the lake is smiling.

objectives.text_en: Dance at the end of the dock

quests.title: 雨后
quests.offer: 雨停的时候，背对太阳看。能看见彩虹的人，运气不会差。
quests.offer_en: When the rain stops, turn your back to the sun. Whoever sees a rainbow will have good luck.
quests.done_en: Seven colours, every one of them.

quests.title: 观星人
quests.offer: 晴朗的夜里抬头看。天上有我们这里的星座：独木舟、狐狸、灯塔……盯着它们看一会儿，就能连成形。找到三个。
quests.offer_en: Look up on a clear night. Our sky has its own constellations: the Canoe, the Fox, the Lighthouse... Gaze at one a while and it joins into a shape. Find three.
quests.done: 你也会认星星了。以后迷路，抬头就好。
quests.done_en: Now you can read the stars. If you are ever lost, look up.

quests.title: 夜访仙境
quests.offer: 湖东南的林子，晴朗的夜里会长出一片仙境。等它出现的时候走进去。
quests.offer_en: The woods south-east of the lake grow a fairy glade on clear nights. Walk in while it is there.
quests.done: 那棵发光的树，是我年轻时种下的。
quests.done_en: That glowing tree — I planted it when I was young.

objectives.text: 在仙境出现时走进仙境林地
objectives.text_en: Enter the Fairy Glade while it is there

quests.title: 沉没之城
quests.offer: 泳池馆地下那口大鱼缸，缸底有一圈很老的石环。潜下去从环里游过去，你会到一座沉在海底的城。替我去看看它的神殿、广场和水渠。
quests.offer_en: In the great tank under the pool house there is a very old ring of stones. Dive down and swim through it, and you will reach a city under the sea. Go and see its temple, its plaza and its aqueduct for me.
quests.done: 城还在，水渠还在流……那就好。
quests.done_en: The city still stands and the aqueduct still flows. Good.

objectives.text: 在亚特兰蒂斯找到山铜神殿、台阶广场和洋流水渠
objectives.text_en: Find the Orichalcum Temple, the Stepped Plaza and the Current Aqueduct in Atlantis

quests.title: 山铜之光
quests.offer: 那座城的尖塔暗了很久了。五尊捧镜的雕像还在，转动它们，把光一尊一尊传到尖塔上。
quests.offer_en: The spire of that city has been dark a long time. The five statues with mirrors still stand; turn them and pass the light, one to the next, up to the spire.
quests.done: 我在这儿都看见了，海底亮了一下。
quests.done_en: I saw it even from here: the sea floor flashed with light.

objectives.text: 让光照到亚特兰蒂斯的山铜尖塔
objectives.text_en: Bring the light to the orichalcum spire of Atlantis

quests.title: 补全星图
quests.offer: 划船的那张星图，还空着三块，对吧？每把一盏灯送回去，湖上的夜空就会多一个星座。晴朗的夜里抬头找找，替那个划船的补上。
quests.offer_en: The paddler's star chart still has three empty places, does it not? Each time a lamp is lit again, the sky over the lake gains a constellation. Look up on clear nights and fill them in for the paddler.
quests.done: 八个星座，一个不少。那张星图，总算画完了。
quests.done_en: Eight constellations, not one missing. That chart is finished at last.

objectives.text: 在湖畔夜空找到天鲸座、石拱座、蝠鲼座
objectives.text_en: Find the Sky Whale, the Stone Arch and the Manta in the lake sky

quests.title: 暮烬之夜
quests.wait: 三盏灯还没有全亮。云上的、沙里的、海底的——等它们都亮了，再回来找我，我有一个故事要讲给你听。
quests.wait_en: The three lamps are not all lit yet. Above the clouds, in the sand, under the sea: when they are all burning, come back to me. I have a story to tell you.
quests.offer: 三盏灯都亮了。今天傍晚，湖上会飘起暮烬。等它们飘起来，回山洞找我，我把最后一个故事讲给你听。
quests.offer_en: All three lamps are lit. This evening the embers will rise over the lake. When they do, come back to the cave and I will tell you my last story.
quests.done: 那个划船的还在路上，对吧？那就好。火我会一直守着。你什么时候回来，湖都在。
quests.done_en: The paddler is still on the road, then? Good. I will keep the fire. Whenever you come back, the lake will be here.

objectives.text: 暮烬飘起的夜里，回山洞听老图腾讲故事
objectives.text_en: On the night the embers rise, hear the Old Totem's story in the cave
Go and look at the stone cottage
